what: Fastenal supplies industrial and construction products: fasteners, tools, safety equipment and cleaning supplies. Its distinctive model is putting vending machines and stocked bins inside customers' own factories.
customers: Manufacturers, construction contractors and government customers, mostly in North America.
money: gloves, protective equipment, cutting tools and cleaning products
moat: Vending machines and managed inventory installed on customer sites, which make reordering automatic and switching suppliers disruptive.
risks: Demand follows manufacturing activity, which has been weak
Growth is modest at about 9% a year
Tariffs raise the cost of imported fasteners
The shares trade at a high multiple for a distributor
opportunities: Return on invested capital near 29% with very little debt
Each new on-site vending installation locks in years of reorders
Customers consolidating suppliers favours the largest distributors
watch: Daily sales growth and the number of weighted on-site locations signed.
